title: Encoded Row Elimination
statement: For any natural numbers $p$ and $\mathrm{inv}$ and any lists $\mathrm{piv}$ and $\mathrm{row}$ of natural numbers, applying the specified row transformation to the encoding of $p$, $\mathrm{inv}$, the tail of $\mathrm{piv}$, and $\mathrm{row}$ yields exactly the encoding of the list whose entries are $(r+p-(\mathrm{row}_0\,\mathrm{inv}\bmod p)y\bmod p)$, paired positionwise with the tails of $\mathrm{row}$ and $\mathrm{piv}$ as in the row-elimination operation. Here $\mathrm{row}_0$ is the head of $\mathrm{row}$, or $0$ when it is empty, and the operation uses the shorter of the two tails, as in positionwise list pairing.
hypotheses_covered: p and inv are natural numbers
piv and row are lists of natural numbers
